verses.geez: ወእምዝ ፡ ጸውዖሙ ፡ ኢየሱስ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ሮቤል ፡ ወለደቂቀ ፡ ጋድ ፡ ወለመንፈቀ ፡ ነገደ ፡ መናሴ ።
verses.translation: Then Joshua called together the sons of Ruben, and the sons of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasse,

translations.lxx: Then Joshua called together the sons of Ruben, and the sons of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasse,
translations.kjv: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh,
translations.ron: Atunci Iosua a chemat seminţia lui Ruben, a lui Gad şi jumătate din a lui Manase şi le-a zis:
translations.grk: Τότε συνεκάλεσεν Ἰησοῦς τοὺς υἱοὺς Ῥουβὴν, καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς Γὰδ, καὶ τὸ ἥμισυ φυλῆς Μανασσῆ,

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ለሊክሙ ፡ ሰማዕክሙ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘአዘዘክሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ቍልዔሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወሰማዕክሙ ፡ ቃልየ ፡ ኵሎ ፡
                  ዘአዘዝኩክሙ ።
verses.translation: and said to them, Ye have heard all that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you, and ye have hearkened to my voice in all that he commanded you.

translations.lxx: and said to them, Ye have heard all that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you, and ye have hearkened to my voice in all that he commanded you.
translations.kjv: And said unto them, Ye have kept all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, and have obeyed my voice in all that I commanded you:
translations.ron: "Voi aţi împlinit toate câte v-a poruncit Domnul prin Moise şi aţi ascultat cuvintele mele întru toate câte v-am poruncit;
translations.grk: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς, ὑμεῖς ἀκηκόατε πάντα ὅσα ἐνετείλατο ὑμῖν Μωυσῆς ὁ παῖς Κυρίου, καὶ ὑπηκούσατε τῆς φωνῆς μου κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἐνετείλατο ὑμῖν.

verses.geez:
ወኢኀደግሙ ፡ አኀዊክሙ ፡ በእማንቱ ፡ መዋዕል ፡ ብዙኃት ፡ እስከ ፡ ዮም ፡ ወእስከ ፡ ዛቲ ፡ ዕለት ፡ ወዐቀብክሙ ፡
                  ትእዛዞ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክክሙ ።
verses.translation: Ye have not deserted your brethren these many days: until this day ye have kept the commandment of the Lord your God.

translations.lxx: Ye have not deserted your brethren these many days: until this day ye have kept the commandment of the Lord your God.
translations.kjv: Ye have not left your brethren these many days unto this day, but have kept the charge of the commandment of the LORD your God.
translations.ron: N-aţi lăsat pe fraţii voştri în toată această îndelungată vreme, până în ziua aceasta şi aţi împlinit cele ce se cuvenea a împlini după porunca Domnului Dumnezeului vostru.
translations.grk: Οὐκ ἐγκαταλελοίπατε τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς ὑμῶν ταύτας τὰς ἡμέρας πλείους· ἕως τῆς σήμερον ἡυμέρας ἐφυλάξατε τὴν ἐντολὴν Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ ὑμῶν.

verses.geez:
ወይእዜሰ ፡ አዕረፎሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክክሙ ፡ ለአኀዊክሙ ፡ በከመ ፡ ይቤሎሙ ፡ ወይእዜኒ ፡ ተመየጡ ፡ ወእትዉ ፡
                  ውስተ ፡ አብያቲክሙ ፡ ወውስተ ፡ ደወልክሙ ፡ ብሔረ ፡ ዘወሀበክሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ገብረ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በማዕዶተ ፡ ዮርዳንስ ።
verses.translation: And now the Lord our God has given our brethren rest, as he told them: now then return and depart to your homes, and to the land of your possession, which Moses gave you on the other side Jordan.

translations.lxx: And now the Lord our God has given our brethren rest, as he told them: now then return and depart to your homes, and to the land of your possession, which Moses gave you on the other side Jordan.
translations.kjv: And now the LORD your God hath given rest unto your brethren, as he promised them: therefore now return ye, and get you unto your tents, and unto the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you on the other side Jordan.
translations.ron: Acum Domnul Dumnezeul vostru a liniştit pe fraţii voştri, cum le spusese. Întoarceţi-vă dar şi duceţi-vă la corturile voastre, în pământul moştenirii voastre, pe care vi l-a dat Moise, sluga Domnului, peste Iordan.
translations.grk: Νῦν δὲ κατέπαυσε Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς ἡμῶν, ὃν τρόπον εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· νῦν οὖν ἀποστραφέντες, ἀπέλθατε εἰς τοὺς οἴκους ὑμῶν, καὶ εἰς τὴν γῆν τῆς κατασχέσεως ὑμῶν, ἣν ἔδωκεν ὑμῖν Μωυσῆς ἐν τῷ πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου.

verses.geez:
ወባሕቱ ፡ ተዓቀቡ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትግበሩ ፡ ጥቀ ፡ ትእዛዘ ፡ ወሕገ ፡ ዘአዘዘክሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትግበሩ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ቍልዔሁ ፡
                  ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ ታፍቅርዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክነ ፡ ወትሑሩ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ፍናዊሁ ፡ ወትዕቀቡ ፡ ትእዛዞ ፡
                  ወትትልውዎ ፡ ወታምልክዎ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ልብክሙ ፡ ወበኵሉ ፡ ነፍስክሙ ።
verses.translation: But take great heed to do the commands and the law, which Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you to do; to love the Lord our God, to walk in all his ways, to keep his commands, and to cleave to him, and serve him with all your mind, and with all your soul.

translations.lxx: But take great heed to do the commands and the law, which Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you to do; to love the Lord our God, to walk in all his ways, to keep his commands, and to cleave to him, and serve him with all your mind, and with all your soul.
translations.kjv: But take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law, which Moses the servant of the LORD charged you, to love the LORD your God, and to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and to cleave unto him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.
translations.ron: Dar să vă siliţi a împlini cu grijă poruncile şi legea pe care v-a dat-o Moise, sluga Domnului: de a iubi pe Domnul Dumnezeul vostru, de a umbla în toate căile Lui, de a păzi poruncile Lui, de a vă lipi de El şi de a-i sluji Lui din toată inima voastră şi din tot sufletul vostru".
translations.grk: Ἀλλὰ φυλάξασθε σφόδρα ποιεῖν τὰς ἐντολὰς καὶ τὸν νόμον, ὃν ἐνετείλατο ἡμῖν ποιεῖν Μωυσῆς ὁ παῖς Κυρίου· ἀγαπᾷν Κύριον τὸν Θεὸν ἡμῶν, πορεύεσθαι πάσαις ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτοῦ, φυλάξασθαι τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ, καὶ προσκεῖσθαι αὐτῷ, καὶ λατρεύειν αὐτῷ ἐξ ὅλης τῆς διανοίας ὑμῶν, καὶ ἐξ ὅλης τῆς ψυχῆς ὑμῶν.

verses.geez: ወባረኮሙ ፡ ኢየሱስ ፡ ወፈነዎሙ ፡ ወአተዉ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አብያቲሆሙ ።
verses.translation: And Joshua blessed them, and dismissed them; and they went to their homes.

translations.lxx: And Joshua blessed them, and dismissed them; and they went to their homes.
translations.kjv: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away: and they went unto their tents.
translations.ron: După aceea Iosua i-a binecuvântat şi le-a dat drumul şi ei s-au împărţit pe la corturile lor.
translations.grk: Καὶ εὐλόγησεν αὐτοὺς Ἰησοῦς, καὶ ἐξαπέστειλεν αὐτούς· καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν εἰς τοὺς οἴκους αὐτῶν.

verses.geez:
ወለመንፈቀ ፡ ነገደ ፡ መናሴ ፡ ወሀቦሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ በባሳን ፡ ወለመንፈቆሙሰ ፡ ወሀቦሙ ፡ ኢየሱስ ፡ ምስለ ፡ አኀዊሆሙ ፡
                  በማዕዶተ ፡ ዮርዳንስ ፡ ዘኀበ ፡ ባሕር ፤ ወሶበ ፡ ፈነዎሙ ፡ ኢየሱስ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አብያቲሆሙ ፡ ወባረኮሙ ፡ ወይቤሎሙ ።
verses.translation: And to one half the tribe of Manasse Moses gave a portion in the land of Basan, and to the other half Joshua gave a portion with his brethren on the other side of Jordan westward: and when Joshua sent them away to their homes, then he blessed them.

translations.lxx: And to one half the tribe of Manasse Moses gave a portion in the land of Basan, and to the other half Joshua gave a portion with his brethren on the other side of Jordan westward: and when Joshua sent them away to their homes, then he blessed them.
translations.kjv: Now to the one half of the tribe of Manasseh Moses had given possession in Bashan: but unto the other half thereof gave Joshua among their brethren on this side Jordan westward. And when Joshua sent them away also unto their tents, then he blessed them,
translations.ron: Unei jumătăţi din seminţia lui Manase i-a dat Moise parte în Vasan, iar celeilalte jumătăţi i-a dat Iosua parte cu fraţii lui dincoace de Iordan, spre apus. Şi când le-a dat drumul Iosua pe la corturile lor şi i-a binecuvântat,
translations.grk: Καὶ τῷ ἡμίσει φυλῆς Μανασσῆ ἔδωκε Μωυσῆς ἐν τῇ Βασανίτιδι, καὶ τῷ ἡμίσει ἔδωκεν Ἰησοῦς μετὰ τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου παρὰ θάλασσαν· καὶ ἡνίκα ἐξαπέστειλεν αὐτοὺς Ἰησοῦς εἰς τοὺς οἴκους αὐτῶν καὶ εὐλόγησεν αὐτούς.

verses.geez:
ወአተዉ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ብዙኅ ፡ ንዋይ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አብያቲሆሙ ፡ ወምስለ ፡ ብዙኅ ፡ እንስሶ ፡ ጥቀ ፡ ወወርቅ ፡ ወብሩር ፡
                  ወብርት ፡ ወኀፂን ፡ ወልብስ ፡ ብዙኅ ፡ ጥቀ ፡ ተካፈሉ ፡ በርበረ ፡ ፀሮሙ ፡ ምስለ ፡ አኀዊሆሙ ።
verses.translation: And they departed with much wealth to their houses, and they divided the spoil of their enemies with their brethren; very much cattle, and silver, and gold, and iron, and much raiment.

translations.lxx: And they departed with much wealth to their houses, and they divided the spoil of their enemies with their brethren; very much cattle, and silver, and gold, and iron, and much raiment.
translations.kjv: And he spake unto them, saying, Return with much riches unto your tents, and with very much cattle, with silver, and with gold, and with brass, and with iron, and with very much raiment: divide the spoil of your enemies with your brethren.
translations.ron: Atunci le-a spus: "Cu mari bogăţii vă întoarceţi voi pe la corturile voastre, cu mare mulţime de vite şi de argint, cu aur, cu aramă şi cu fier şi cu mare mulţime de haine: să împărţiţi dar prada cu fraţii voştri".
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐν χρήμασι πολλοῖς ἀπήλθοσαν εἰς τοὺς οἴκους αὐτῶν· καὶ κτήνη πολλὰ σφόδρα, καὶ ἀργύριον, καὶ χρυσίον, καὶ σίδηρον, καὶ ἱματισμὸν πολὺν, διείλαντο τὴν προνομὴν τῶν ἐχθρῶν μετὰ τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτῶν.

verses.geez:
ወተመይጡ ፡ ወአተዉ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ሮቤል ፡ ወደቂቀ ፡ ጋድ ፡ ወመንፈቀ ፡ ነገደ ፡ መናሴ ፡ እምነ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡
                  እምነ ፡ ሴሎ ፡ እምነ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ከናአን ፡ ከመ ፡ ይሑሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ገላአድ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ ወውስተ ፡
                  ርስቶሙ ፡ [ዘተዋረስዋ ፡] በትእዛዘ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በእደ ፡ ሙሴ ።
verses.translation: So the sons of Ruben, and the sons of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasse, departed from the children of Israel in Selo in the land of Chanaan, to go away into Galaad, into the land of their possession, which they inherited by the command of the Lord, by the hand of Moses.

translations.lxx: So the sons of Ruben, and the sons of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasse, departed from the children of Israel in Selo in the land of Chanaan, to go away into Galaad, into the land of their possession, which they inherited by the command of the Lord, by the hand of Moses.
translations.kjv: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go unto the country of Gilead, to the land of their possession, whereof they were possessed, according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
translations.ron: Şi s-au întors fiii lui Ruben şi ai lui Gad şi jumătate din seminţia lui Manase şi au plecat de la fiii lui Israel din Şilo, care e în pământul Canaanului, ca să meargă în ţara Galaadului, în pământul moştenirii lor, pe care îl luaseră în stăpânire după porunca Domnului dată prin Moise.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ῥουβὴν, καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Γὰδ, καὶ τὸ ἥμισυ φυλῆς Μανασσῆ ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ ἐν Σηλὼ ἐν γῇ Χαναὰν ἀπελθεῖν εἰς τὴν Γαλαὰδ εἰς γῆν κατασχέσεως αὐτῶν, ἣν ἐκληρονόμησαν αὐτὴν διὰ προστάγματος Κυρίου ἐν χειρὶ Μωυσῆ.

verses.geez:
ወበጽሑ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ገላአድ ፡ ዘዮርዳንስ ፡ ዘምድረ ፡ ከናአን ፡ ወነደቁ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ጋድ ፡ ወደቂቀ ፡ ሮቤል ፡ ወመንፈቀ
                  ፡ ነገደ ፡ መናሴ ፡ በህየ ፡ ምሥዋዐ ፡ በኀበ ፡ ዮርዳንስ ፡ ዐቢየ ፡ ምሥዋዐ ፡ ዘያስተርኢ ።
verses.translation: And they came to Galaad of Jordan, which is in the land of Chanaan: and the children of Ruben, and the children of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasse built there an altar by Jordan, a great altar to look at.

translations.lxx: And they came to Galaad of Jordan, which is in the land of Chanaan: and the children of Ruben, and the children of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasse built there an altar by Jordan, a great altar to look at.
translations.kjv: And when they came unto the borders of Jordan, that are in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh built there an altar by Jordan, a great altar to see to.
translations.ron: Şi ajungând în preajma Iordanului ce e în rara Canaan, fiii lui Ruben şi fiii lui Gad şi jumătate din seminţia lui Manase au zidit acolo lângă Iordan jertfelnic, jertfelnic mare la vedere.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἦλθον εἰς Γαλαὰδ τοῦ Ἰορδάνου, ἥ ἐστιν ἐν γῇ Χαναάν· καὶ ᾠκοδόμησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ῥουβὴν, καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Γὰδ, καὶ τὸ ἥμισυ φυλῆς Μανασσῆ ἐκεῖ βωμὸν ἐπὶ τοῦ Ἰορδάνου, βωμὸν μέγαν τοῦ ἰδεῖν.

verses.geez:
ወሰምዑ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ከመ ፡ ነደቁ ፡ ምሥዋዐ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ጋድ ፡ ወደቂቀ ፡ ሮቤል ፡ ወመንፈቂ ፡ ነገደ ፡
                  መናሴ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ደወለ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ከናአን ፡ በኀበ ፡ ገላአድ ፡ ዘዮርዳንስ ፡ በማዕዶቶሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: And the children of Israel heard say, Behold, the sons of Ruben, and the sons of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasse have built an altar at the borders of the land of Chanaan at Galaad of Jordan, on the opposite side to the children of Israel.

translations.lxx: And the children of Israel heard say, Behold, the sons of Ruben, and the sons of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasse have built an altar at the borders of the land of Chanaan at Galaad of Jordan, on the opposite side to the children of Israel.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel heard say, Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh have built an altar over against the land of Canaan, in the borders of Jordan, at the passage of the children of Israel.
translations.ron: Şi au auzit fiii lui Israel că se zicea: "Iată fiii lui Ruben şi fiii lui Gad şi jumătate din seminţia lui Manase au zidit jertfelnic pe pământul Canaanului, în preajma Iordanului, în faţa fiilor lui Israel".
translations.grk: Καὶ ἤκουσαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ λεγόντων, Ἰδοῦ ᾠκοδομήκασιν οἱ υἱοὶ Ῥουβὴν, καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Γὰδ, καὶ τὸ ἥμισυ φυλῆς Μανασσῆ βωμὸν ἐφʼ ὁρίων γῆς Χαναὰν ἐπὶ τοῦ Γαλαὰδ τοῦ Ἰορδάνου ἐν τῷ πέραν υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ.

verses.geez:
ወሰምዑ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወተጋብኡ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሴሎ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይዕረጉ ፡ ይትቃተልዎሙ
                  ።
verses.translation: And all the children of Israel gathered together to Selo, so as to go up and fight against them.

translations.lxx: And all the children of Israel gathered together to Selo, so as to go up and fight against them.
translations.kjv: And when the children of Israel heard of it, the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up to war against them.
translations.ron: Când au auzit acestea fiii lui Israel, s-a adunat toată obştea fiilor lui Israel la Şilo, ca să meargă împotriva lor cu război.
translations.grk: Καὶ συνηθροίσθησαν πάντες οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ εἰς Σηλὼ, ὥστε ἀναβάντες ἐκπολεμῆσαι αὐτούς.

verses.geez:
ወለአኩ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ኀበ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ሮቤል ፡ ወኀበ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ጋድ ፡ ወኀበ ፡ መንፈቀ ፡ ነገደ ፡ መናሴ ፡
                  ውስተ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ገላአድ ፡ ፊንሕስ ፡ ወልደ ፡ እልዐዛር ፡ ወልደ ፡ አሮን ፡ ካህን ፤
verses.translation: And the children of Israel sent to the sons of Ruben, and the sons of Gad, and to the sons of the half tribe of Manasse into the land of Galaad, both Phinees the son of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest,

translations.lxx: And the children of Israel sent to the sons of Ruben, and the sons of Gad, and to the sons of the half tribe of Manasse into the land of Galaad, both Phinees the son of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest,
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel sent unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest,
translations.ron: Dar fiii lui Israel au trimis mai întâi la fiii lui Ruben, la fiii lui Gad şi la jumătate din seminţia lui Manase, în ţara Galaadului, pe Finees, fiul preotului Eleazar,
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπέστειλαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ πρὸς τοὺς υἱοὺς Ῥουβὴν καὶ πρὸς τοὺς υἱοὺς Γὰδ καὶ πρὸς τοὺς υἱοὺς ἥμισυ φυλῆς Μανασσῆ εἰς γῆν Γαλαὰδ, τόν τε Φινεὲς υἱὸν Ἐλεάζαρ υἱοῦ Ἀαρὼν τοῦ ἀρχιερέως,

verses.geez:
ወዐሠርቱ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ መላእክት ፡ ምስሌሁ ፡ (ወ)መልአክ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ እምነ ፡ አብያተ ፡ አበዊሆሙ ፡ እምነ ፡ ኵሉ ፡
                  ነገደ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ዕደወ ፡ መላእክተ ፡ አብያተ ፡ ኦበዊሆሙ ፡ መሳፍንት ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ለእስራኤል ።
verses.translation: and ten of the chiefs with him; there was one chief of every household out of all the tribes of Israel; (the heads of families are the captains of thousands in Israel.)

translations.lxx: and ten of the chiefs with him; there was one chief of every household out of all the tribes of Israel; (the heads of families are the captains of thousands in Israel.)
translations.kjv: And with him ten princes, of each chief house a prince throughout all the tribes of Israel; and each one was an head of the house of their fathers among the thousands of Israel.
translations.ron: Împreună cu zece căpetenii, câte o căpetenie de fiecare seminţie a lui Israel de dincoace de Iordan; fiecare din aceştia era căpetenie de mie din seminţiile lui Israel.
translations.grk: καὶ δέκα τῶν ἀρχόντων μετʼ αὐτοῦ· ἄρχων εἷς ἀπὸ οἴκου πατριᾶς ἀπὸ πασῶν φυλῶν Ἰσραήλ· ἄρχοντες οἴκων πατριῶν εἰσι χιλίαρχοι Ἰσραήλ.

verses.geez:
ወበጽሑ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ጋድ ፡ ወኀበ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ሮቤል ፡ ወኀበ ፡ መንፈቀ ፡ ነገደ ፡ መናሴ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ገላአድ ፡
                  ወነገርዎሙ ፡ ወይቤልዎሙ ፤
verses.translation: And they came to the sons of Ruben, and to the sons of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasse into the land of Galaad; and they spoke to them, saying,

translations.lxx: And they came to the sons of Ruben, and to the sons of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasse into the land of Galaad; and they spoke to them, saying,
translations.kjv: And they came unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, unto the land of Gilead, and they spake with them, saying,
translations.ron: Şi au venit ei la fiii lui Ruben şi la fiii lui Gad şi la jumătatea seminţiei lui Manase în pământul Galaadului şi au vorbit cu ei şi le-a zis:
translations.grk: Καὶ παρεγένοντο πρὸς τοὺς υἱοὺς Ῥουβὴν, καὶ πρὸς τοὺς υἱοὺς Γὰδ, καὶ πρὸς τοὺς ἡμίσεις φυλῆς Μανασσῆ εἰς γῆν Γαλαάδ· καὶ ἐλάλησαν πρὸς αὐτοὺς, λέγοντες,

verses.geez:
ከመዝ ፡ ይቤሉ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ተዓይነ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ምንትኑአ ፡ ዛቲአ ፡ አበሳአ ፡ እንተ ፡ አበስክሙ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ አምላከ
                  ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ከመ ፡ ትኅድጉ ፡ ዮም ፡ ተሊዎቶ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወትንድቁ ፡ ለክሙ ፡ ምሥዋዐ ፡ ወከመ ፡ ትክሐድዎ ፡ ዮም
                  ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: Thus says the whole congregation of the Lord, What is this transgression that ye have transgressed before the God of Israel, to turn away today from the Lord, in that ye have built for yourselves an altar, so that ye should be apostates from the Lord?

translations.lxx: Thus says the whole congregation of the Lord, What is this transgression that ye have transgressed before the God of Israel, to turn away today from the Lord, in that ye have built for yourselves an altar, so that ye should be apostates from the Lord?
translations.kjv: Thus saith the whole congregation of the LORD, What trespass is this that ye have committed against the God of Israel, to turn away this day from following the LORD, in that ye have builded you an altar, that ye might rebel this day against the LORD?
translations.ron: "Aşa grăieşte toată obştea Domnului: Ce înseamnă nelegiuirea aceasta pe care aţi făcut-o înaintea Domnului Dumnezeului lui Israel, abătându-vă acum de la Domnul Dumnezeul lui Israel, ridicându-vă jertfelnic şi sculându-vă acum împotriva Domnului?
translations.grk: τάδε λέγει πᾶσα ἡ συναγωγὴ Κυρίου, τίς ἡ πλημμέλεια αὕτη, ἣν ἐπλημμελήσατε ἐναντίον τοῦ Θεοῦ Ἰσραὴλ, ἀποστραφῆναι σήμερον ἀπὸ Κυρίου, οἰκοδομήσαντες ὑμῖν ἑαυτοῖς βωμὸν, ἀποστάτας ὑμᾶς γενέσθαι ἀπὸ τοῦ Κυρίου;

verses.geez:
አስተንአስክሙኑ ፡ ኀጢአቶ ፡ ለፌጎር ፡ እንተ ፡ ኢነጻሕነ ፡ እምኔሃ ፡ እስከ ፡ ዮም ፡ ወኮነ ፡ መቅሠፍት ፡ ላዕለ ፡
                  ትዕይንተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: Is the sin of Phogor too little for you, whereas we have not been cleansed from it until this day, though there was a plague among the congregation of the Lord?

translations.lxx: Is the sin of Phogor too little for you, whereas we have not been cleansed from it until this day, though there was a plague among the congregation of the Lord?
translations.kjv: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we are not cleansed until this day, although there was a plague in the congregation of the LORD,
translations.ron: Nu vă ajunge oare păcatul din Peor, de care nu ne-am spălat nici până în ziua de astăzi şi pentru care a fost bătută obştea de Domnul?
translations.grk: Μὴ μικρὸν ἡμῖν τὸ ἁμάρτημα Φογὼρ, ὅτι οὐκ ἐκαθαρίσθημεν ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης; καὶ ἐγενήθη πληγὴ ἐν τῇ συναγωγῇ Κυρίου.

verses.geez:
ወዮምኒ ፡ አንትሙ ፡ ኀደግሙ ፡ ተሊዎቶ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወእምከመ ፡ አንትሙ ፡ ዮም ፡ ክሕድክምዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡
                  ጌሠመ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ይከውን ፡ መቅሠፍት ።
verses.translation: And ye have this day revolted from the Lord; and it shall come to pass if ye revolt this day from the Lord, that to-morrow there shall be wrath upon all Israel.

translations.lxx: And ye have this day revolted from the Lord; and it shall come to pass if ye revolt this day from the Lord, that to-morrow there shall be wrath upon all Israel.
translations.kjv: But that ye must turn away this day from following the LORD? and it will be, seeing ye rebel to day against the LORD, that to morrow he will be wroth with the whole congregation of Israel.
translations.ron: Şi iată astăzi voi vă abateţi de la Domnul! Astăzi voi vă sculaţi împotriva Domnului, iar mâine se va mânia Domnul pe toată obştea lui Israel.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὑμεῖς ἀπεστράφητε σήμερον ἀπὸ Κυρίου· καὶ ἔσται ἐὰν ἀποστῆτε σήμερον ἀπὸ Κυρίου, καὶ αὔριον ἐπὶ πάντα Ἰσραὴλ ἔσται ἡ ὀργή.

verses.geez:
ወይእዜኒ ፡ እመ ፡ ትንእሰክሙ ፡ ደወለ ፡ ምድርክሙ ፡ ዕድው ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ደወለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ኀበ ፡ ትነብር
                  ፡ ህየ ፡ ደብተራሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወተወረሱ ፡ ምስሌነ ፡ ወኢትክሐድዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወኢትኅድግዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡
                  እስመ ፡ ነደቅሙ ፡ ምሥዋዐ ፡ አፍአ ፡ እምነ ፡ ምሥዋዒሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክነ ።
verses.translation: And now if the land of your possession be too little, cross over to the land of the possession of the Lord, where the tabernacle of the Lord dwells, and receive ye an inheritance among us; and do not become apostates from God, neither do ye apostatize from the Lord, because of your having built an altar apart from the altar of the Lord our God.

translations.lxx: And now if the land of your possession be too little, cross over to the land of the possession of the Lord, where the tabernacle of the Lord dwells, and receive ye an inheritance among us; and do not become apostates from God, neither do ye apostatize from the Lord, because of your having built an altar apart from the altar of the Lord our God.
translations.kjv: Notwithstanding, if the land of your possession be unclean, then pass ye over unto the land of the possession of the LORD, wherein the LORD’s tabernacle dwelleth, and take possession among us: but rebel not against the LORD, nor rebel against us, in building you an altar beside the altar of the LORD our God.
translations.ron: Dacă însă pământul moştenirii voastre vi se pare necurat, atunci treceţi în pământul moştenirii Domnului, unde se află cortul Domnului, luaţi-vă parte între noi, dar nu vă ridicaţi împotriva Domnului, nici împotriva noastră nu vă ridicaţi, zidindu-vă jertfelnic afară de cel al Domnului Dumnezeului nostru.
translations.grk: Καὶ νῦν εἰ μικρὰ ἡ γῆ ὑμῶν τῆς κατασχέσεως ὑμῶν, διάβητε εἰς τὴν γῆν τῆς Κυρίου κατασχέσεως, οὗ κατασκηνοῖ ἐκεῖ ἡ σκηνὴ Κυρίου, καὶ κατακληρονομήσετε ἐν ἡμῖν· καὶ μὴ ἀπὸ Θεοῦ ἀποστάται γενήθητε, καὶ ὑμεῖς μηδʼ ἀπόστητε ἀπὸ Κυρίου, διὰ τὸ οἰκοδομῆσαι ὑμᾶς βωμὸν ἔξω τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν.

verses.geez:
አካኑ ፡ አካር ፡ ወልደ ፡ [ዛራ ፡] አበሰ ፡ ወጌገየ ፡ ወነሥአ ፡ እምነ ፡ ዘሕሩም ፡ ወላዕለ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ትዕይንተ ፡
                  እስራኤል ፡ ኮነ ፡ መንሱት ፡ እንዘ ፡ ባሕቲቱ ፡ አበሰ ፡ ቦኑአ ፡ ባሕቲቱአ ፡ ሞተአ ፡ በኀጢአቱአ ።
verses.translation: Lo! did not Achar the son of Zara commit a trespass taking of the accursed thing, and there was wrath on the whole congregation of Israel? and he himself died alone in his own sin.

translations.lxx: Lo! did not Achar the son of Zara commit a trespass taking of the accursed thing, and there was wrath on the whole congregation of Israel? and he himself died alone in his own sin.
translations.kjv: Did not Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the accursed thing, and wrath fell on all the congregation of Israel? and that man perished not alone in his iniquity.
translations.ron: Oare n-a făcut singur Acan, fiul lui Zerah, nelegiuire, luând din cele date nimicirii, dar mânia a venit asupra a toată obştea fiilor lui Israel? Şi oare numai el singur a murit pentru nelegiuire?"
translations.grk: Οὐκ ἰδοὺ Ἄχαρ ὁ τοῦ Ζαρᾶ πλημμελείᾳ ἐπλημμέλησεν ἀπὸ τοῦ ἀναθέματος, καὶ ἐπὶ πᾶσαν συναγωγὴν Ἰσραὴλ ἐγενήθη ὀργή; καὶ οὗτος εἷς αὐτὸς ἀπέθανε τῇ ἑαυτοῦ ἁμαρτίᾳ.

verses.geez:
ወአውሥኡ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ሮቤል ፡ ወደቂቀ ፡ ጋድ ፡ ወመንፈቀ ፡ ነገደ ፡ መናሴ ፡ ወይቤልዎሙ ፡ ለመላእክተ ፡ እስራኤል ፡
                  እንዘ ፡ ይብሉ ፤
verses.translation: And the sons of Ruben, and the sons of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasse answered, and spoke to the captains of the thousands of Israel, saying,

translations.lxx: And the sons of Ruben, and the sons of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasse answered, and spoke to the captains of the thousands of Israel, saying,
translations.kjv: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh answered, and said unto the heads of the thousands of Israel,
translations.ron: Atunci fiii lui Ruben şi fiii lui Gad şi jumătate din seminţia lui Manase, răspunzând la acestea, au zis căpeteniilor lui Israel:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπεκρίθησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ῥουβὴν, καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Γὰδ, καὶ τὸ ἥμισυ φυλῆς Μανασσῆ, καὶ ἐλάλησαν τοῖς χιλιάρχοις Ἰσραὴλ, λέγοντες,

verses.geez:
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ውእቱ ፡ አምላክ ፡ ወእግዚእ ፡ ወአምላከ ፡ አማልክት ፡ ውእቱ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ያአምር ፡ ወለእስራኤልኒ
                  ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ያአምሮ ፡ ከመ ፡ አኮ ፡ ለክሒድ ፡ ወለአብሶ ፡ ዘገበርነ ፡ ቅድሜሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወእመአኮሰ ፡ ኢያድኅነነ
                  ፡ ዮም ።
verses.translation: God even God is the Lord, and God even God himself knows, and Israel he shall know; if we have transgressed before the Lord by apostasy, let him not deliver us this day.

translations.lxx: God even God is the Lord, and God even God himself knows, and Israel he shall know; if we have transgressed before the Lord by apostasy, let him not deliver us this day.
translations.kjv: The LORD God of gods, the LORD God of gods, he knoweth, and Israel he shall know; if it be in rebellion, or if in transgression against the LORD, (save us not this day,)
translations.ron: "Dumnezeul dumnezeilor este Domnul şi Domnul Dumnezeul dumnezeilor ştie şi să ştie şi Israel: de ne răzvrătim şi ne abatem noi de la Domnul, atunci să nu ne cruţe pe noi Domnul astăzi!
translations.grk: ὁ Θεὸς Θεὸς Κύριός ἐστι, καὶ ὁ Θεὸς Θεὸς αὐτὸς οἶδε, καὶ Ἰσραὴλ αὐτὸς γνώσεται· εἰ ἐν ἀποστασίᾳ ἐπλημμελήσαμεν ἔναντι τοῦ Κυρίου, μὴ ῥύσαιτο ἡμᾶς ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ταύτῃ.

verses.geez:
ወእመኒ ፡ ምሥዋዐ ፡ ነደቅነ ፡ ለነ ፡ ከመ ፡ ንክሐዶ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክነ ፡ ወከመ ፡ ናዕርግ ፡ ውስቴቱ ፡
                  መሥዋዕተ ፡ ቍርባን ፡ ወእመኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ ንግበር ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ መሥዋዕተ ፡ መድኅኒት ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ለሊሁ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
                  ለይትኀሠሠነ ።
verses.translation: And if we have built to ourselves an altar, so as to apostatize from the Lord our God, so as to offer upon it a sacrifice of whole-burnt-offerings, so as to offer upon it a sacrifice of peace-offering,—the Lord shall require it.

translations.lxx: And if we have built to ourselves an altar, so as to apostatize from the Lord our God, so as to offer upon it a sacrifice of whole-burnt-offerings, so as to offer upon it a sacrifice of peace-offering,—the Lord shall require it.
translations.kjv: That we have built us an altar to turn from following the LORD, or if to offer thereon burnt offering or meat offering, or if to offer peace offerings thereon, let the LORD himself require it;
translations.ron: Şi dacă am ridicat noi un jertfelnic, ca să ne abatem de la Domnul Dumnezeul nostru şi ca să aducem pe el arderi de tot şi prinos de pâine şi ca să săvârşim pe el jertfe de împăcare, atunci Domnul să ne ceară socoteală de aceasta!
translations.grk: Καὶ εἰ ᾠκοδομήσαμεν ἑαυτοῖς βωμὸν, ὥστε ἀποστῆναι ἀπὸ Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν, ὥστε ἀναβιβάσαι ἐπʼ αὐτὸν θυσίαν ὁλοκαυτωμάτων, ὥστε ποιῆσαι ἐπʼ αὐτοῦ θυσίαν σωτηρίου, Κύριος ἐκζητήσει.

verses.geez:
እመ ፡ አኮ ፡ በበይነ ፡ ነገረ ፡ ፍርሀተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ዘገበርናሁ ፡ ለዝንቱ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ንብል ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢይበሉ ፡
                  ጌሠመ ፡ ውሉድክሙ ፡ ለውሉድነ ፡ ምንተ ፡ ብክሙ ፡ ምስለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላከ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: But we have done this for the sake of precaution concerning this thing, saying, Lest hereafter your sons should say to our sons, What have ye to do with the Lord God of Israel?

translations.lxx: But we have done this for the sake of precaution concerning this thing, saying, Lest hereafter your sons should say to our sons, What have ye to do with the Lord God of Israel?
translations.kjv: And if we have not rather done it for fear of this thing, saying, In time to come your children might speak unto our children, saying, What have ye to do with the LORD God of Israel?
translations.ron: Dar noi am făcut aceasta de teamă ca nu cumva în viitor fiii voştri să zică fiilor noştri: "Ce aveţi voi cu Domnul Dumnezeul lui Israel?
translations.grk: Ἀλλʼ ἕνεκεν εὐλαβείας ῥήματος ἐποιήσαμεν τοῦτο, λέγοντες, ἵνα μὴ εἴπωσιν αὔριον τὰ τέκνα ὑμῶν τοῖς τέκνοις ἡμῶν, τί ὑμῖν Κυρίῳ τῷ Θεῷ Ἰσραήλ;

verses.geez:
እስመ ፡ አቀመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወሰነ ፡ ማእከሌክሙ ፡ ወማእከሌነ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ሮቤል ፡ ወለደቂቀ ፡ ጋድ ፡ ወለመንፈቀ
                  ፡ ነገደ ፡ መናሴ ፡ [ለዮርዳንስ ፡] ወአልብክሙ ፡ ክፍለ ፡ ምስለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወይሬስይዎሙ ፡ ነኪረ ፡ ውሉድክሙ ፡
                  ለውሉድነ ፡ (ከመ ፡ ኢያውፅ[እዎ]ሙ ፡) እምነ ፡ አምልኮ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: Whereas the Lord has set boundaries between us and you, even Jordan, and ye have no portion in the Lord: so your sons shall alienate our sons, that they should not worship the Lord.

translations.lxx: Whereas the Lord has set boundaries between us and you, even Jordan, and ye have no portion in the Lord: so your sons shall alienate our sons, that they should not worship the Lord.
translations.kjv: For the LORD hath made Jordan a border between us and you, ye children of Reuben and children of Gad; ye have no part in the LORD: so shall your children make our children cease from fearing the LORD.
translations.ron: Domnul a pus hotar între noi şi voi, fiii lui Ruben şi fiii lui Gad şi jumătatea seminţiei lui Manase, Iordanul; voi n-aveţi deci nici o legătură cu Domnul". Şi astfel fiii voştri nu vor îngădui fiilor noştri să se închine Domnului în Şilo.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὅρια ἔθηκε Κύριος ἀναμέσον ἡμῶν καὶ ὑμῶν τὸν Ἰορδάνην, καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ὑμῖν μερὶς Κυρίου· καὶ ἀπαλλοτριώσουσιν οἱ υἱοὶ ὑμῶν τοὺς υἱῶν ἡμῶν, ἵνα μὴ σέβωνται Κύριον.

verses.geez:
ወንቤ ፡ ከመ ፡ ንግበር ፡ ከመዝ ፡ ወንንድቅ ፡ ዘንተ ፡ ምሥዋዐ ፡ አኮ ፡ በበይነ ፡ ቍርባን ፡ ወአኮ ፡ በበይነ ፡
                  መሥዋዕት ።
verses.translation: And we gave orders to do thus, to build this altar, not for burnt-offerings, nor for meat-offerings;

translations.lxx: And we gave orders to do thus, to build this altar, not for burnt-offerings, nor for meat-offerings;
translations.kjv: Therefore we said, Let us now prepare to build us an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice:
translations.ron: De aceea am zis noi: Să ne facem un jertfelnic, nu pentru arderi de tot nici pentru jertfe,
translations.grk: Καὶ εἴπαμεν ποιῆσαι οὕτω, τοῦ οἰκοδομῆσαι τὸν βωμὸν τοῦτον οὐχ ἕνεκεν καρπωμάτων οὐδὲ ἕνεκεν θυσιῶν,

verses.geez:
አላ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይኩን ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ስም[ዐ] ፡ ማእከሌነ ፡ ወማእከሌክሙ ፡ ወማእከለ ፡ ውሉድነ ፡ እምድኅሬነ ፡ ከመ ፡
                  ያምልክዎ ፡ አምልከ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በቅድሜሁ ፡ በቍርባንክሙ ፡ ወበመሥዋዕተ ፡ መድኀኒትክሙ ፡ ወኢይበልዎሙ ፡ ውሉድክሙ ፡
                  ለውሉድነ ፡ ጌሠመ ፡ አልብክሙ ፡ ክፍለ ፡ ምስለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: but that this may be a witness between you and us, and between our posterity after us, that we may do service to the Lord before him, with our burnt-offerings and our meat-offerings and our peace-offerings: so your sons shall not say to our sons, hereafter, Ye have no portion in the Lord.

translations.lxx: but that this may be a witness between you and us, and between our posterity after us, that we may do service to the Lord before him, with our burnt-offerings and our meat-offerings and our peace-offerings: so your sons shall not say to our sons, hereafter, Ye have no portion in the Lord.
translations.kjv: But that it may be a witness between us, and you, and our generations after us, that we might do the service of the LORD before him with our burnt offerings, and with our sacrifices, and with our peace offerings; that your children may not say to our children in time to come, Ye have no part in the LORD.
translations.ron: Ci ca să fie el între noi şi voi, între urmaşii noştri, mărturie că noi putem sluji Domnului cu arderile de tot ale noastre şi cu jertfele noastre şi cu cele de împăcare ale noastre, şi pentru ca în vremurile viitoare să nu zică fiii voştri către fiii noştri: Voi nu aveţi nici o legătură cu Domnul.
translations.grk: ἀλλʼ ἵνα ᾖ τοῦτο μαρτύριον ἀναμέσον ἡμῶν καὶ ὑμῶν, καὶ ἀναμέσον τῶν γενεῶν ἡμῶν μεθʼ ἡμᾶς, τοῦ λατρεύειν λατρείαν Κυρίου ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ, ἐν τοῖς καρπώμασιν ἡμῶν καὶ ἐν ταῖς θυσίαις ἡμῶν καὶ ἐν ταῖς θυσίαις τῶν σωτηρίων ἡμῶν· καὶ οὐκ ἐροῦσι τὰ τέκνα ὑμῶν τοῖς τέκνοις ἡμῶν αὔριον, οὐκ ἔστιν ὑμῖν μερὶς Κυρίου.

verses.geez:
ወንቤ ፡ እመቦ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኮነ ፡ ድኅረ ፡ ወይቤሉነ ፡ ጌሠመ ፡ አው ፡ ለውሉድነ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይቤልዎሙ ፡ ናሁ ፡ ርእዩ ፡
                  አምሳለ ፡ [ምሥዋዑ ፡] ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ዘገብሩ ፡ አበዊነ ፡ አኮ ፡ በበይነ ፡ ቍርባን ፡ ወአኮ ፡ በበይነ ፡ መሥዋዕት ፡
                  አላ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይኩን ፡ ስምዕ ፡ ማእከሌነ ፡ ወማእከሌክሙ ።
verses.translation: And we said, If ever it should come to pass that they should speak so to us, or to our posterity hereafter; then shall they say, Behold the likeness of the altar of the Lord, which our fathers made, not for the sake of burnt-offerings, nor for the sake of meat-offerings, but it is a witness between you and us, and between our sons.

translations.lxx: And we said, If ever it should come to pass that they should speak so to us, or to our posterity hereafter; then shall they say, Behold the likeness of the altar of the Lord, which our fathers made, not for the sake of burnt-offerings, nor for the sake of meat-offerings, but it is a witness between you and us, and between our sons.
translations.kjv: Therefore said we, that it shall be, when they should so say to us or to our generations in time to come, that we may say again, Behold the pattern of the altar of the LORD, which our fathers made, not for burnt offerings, nor for sacrifices; but it is a witness between us and you.
translations.ron: Şi ziceam noi: Dacă ni se va zice astfel nouă şi urmaşilor noştri, atunci vom răspunde: Priviţi chipul jertfelnicului Domnului pe care l-au făcut părinţii noştri nu pentru arderi de tot şi nu pentru jertfe, ci ca să fie mărturie între noi şi voi şi între fiii noştri şi fiii voştri.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἴπαμεν, ἐὰν γένηταί ποτε καὶ λαλήσωσι πρὸς ἡμᾶς, ἢ ταῖς γενεαῖς ἡμῶν αὔριον, καὶ ἐροῦσιν, ἴδετε ὁμοίωμα τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου Κυρίου, ὃ ἐποίησαν οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν οὐχ ἕνεκεν καρπωμάτων οὐδὲ ἕνεκεν θυσιῶν, ἀλλὰ μαρτύριόν ἐστιν ἀναμέσον ὑμῶν καὶ ἀναμέσον ἡμῶν, καὶ ἀναμέσον τῶν υἱῶν ἡμῶν.

verses.geez:
ሐሰ ፡ ለነ ፡ እስከ ፡ ነኀድግ ፡ ተሊዎቶ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በእላንቱ ፡ መዋዕል ፡ ዮም ፡ ከመ ፡ ንክሐዶ ፡
                  ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወከመ ፡ ንንድቅ ፡ ለነ ፡ ምሥዋዐ ፡ ለቍርባን ፡ ወለመሥዋዕተ ፡ ሰላም ፡ ወለመሥዋዕተ ፡ መድኀኒት ፡ እንበለ
                  ፡ በውስተ ፡ ምሥዋዒሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክነ ፡ [ዘቅድመ ፡ ደብተራሁ ።]
verses.translation: Far be it from us therefore that we should turn away from the Lord this day so as to apostatize from the Lord, so as that we should build an altar for burnt-offerings, and for peace-offerings, besides the altar of the Lord which is before his tabernacle.

translations.lxx: Far be it from us therefore that we should turn away from the Lord this day so as to apostatize from the Lord, so as that we should build an altar for burnt-offerings, and for peace-offerings, besides the altar of the Lord which is before his tabernacle.
translations.kjv: God forbid that we should rebel against the LORD, and turn this day from following the LORD, to build an altar for burnt offerings, for meat offerings, or for sacrifices, beside the altar of the LORD our God that is before his tabernacle.
translations.ron: Să nu se întâmple una ca aceea ca să ne ridicăm noi împotriva Domnului şi să ne abatem acum de la Domnul şi să facem jertfelnic pentru arderi de tot şi pentru prinos de pâine şi pentru jertfe, afară de jertfelnicul Domnului Dumnezeu care se află înaintea cortului".
translations.grk: Μὴ γένοιτο οὖν ἡμᾶς ἀποστραφῆναι ἀπὸ Κυρίου ἐν τῇ σήμερον ἡμέρᾳ ἀποστῆναι ἀπὸ Κυρίου, ὥστε οἰκοδομῆσαι ἡμᾶς θυσιαστήριον τοῖς καρπώμασι, καὶ ταῖς θυσίαις Σαλαμὶν, καὶ τῇ θυσίᾳ τοῦ σωτηρίου, πλὴν τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου Κυρίου ὅ ἐστιν ἐναντίον τῆς σκηνῆς αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወሶበ ፡ ሰምዐ ፡ ፊንሕስ ፡ ካህን ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ መላእክተ ፡ ተዓይን ፡ ወመሳፍንተ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ እለ ፡ ምስሌሁ ፡ ቃለ ፡
                  ዘይቤልዎሙ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ሮቤል ፡ ወደቂቀ ፡ ጋድ ፡ ወመንፈቀ ፡ ነገደ ፡ መናሴ ፡ አርመሙ ።
verses.translation: And Phinees the priest and all the chiefs of the congregation of Israel who were with him heard the words which the children of Ruben, and the children of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasse spoke; and it pleased them.

translations.lxx: And Phinees the priest and all the chiefs of the congregation of Israel who were with him heard the words which the children of Ruben, and the children of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasse spoke; and it pleased them.
translations.kjv: And when Phinehas the priest, and the princes of the congregation and heads of the thousands of Israel which were with him, heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spake, it pleased them.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀκούσας Φινεὲς ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ πάντες οἱ ἄρχοντες τῆς συναγωγῆς Ἰσραὴλ οἳ ἦσαν μετʼ αὐτοῦ, τοὺς λόγους οὓς ἐλάλησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ῥουβὴν καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Γὰδ καὶ τὸ ἥμισυ φυλῆς Μανασσῆ, καὶ ἤρεσεν αὐτοῖς.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ፊንሕስ ፡ ወልደ ፡ እልዐዛር ፡ ካህን ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ሮቤል ፡ ወለደቂቀ ፡ ጋድ ፡ ወለመንፈቀ ፡ ነገደ ፡ መናሴ
                  ፡ ዮም ፡ አእመርነ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሀለወ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ምስሌነ ፡ እስመ ፡ ኢአበስክሙ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ዛተ ፡
                  ኀጢአተ ፡ ወእስመ ፡ አድኀንክምዎሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ እምእዴሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And Phinees the priest said to the sons of Ruben, and to the sons of Gad, and to the half of the tribe of Manasse, To-day we know that the Lord is with us, because ye have not trespassed grievously against the Lord, and because ye have delivered the children of Israel out of the hand of the Lord.

translations.lxx: And Phinees the priest said to the sons of Ruben, and to the sons of Gad, and to the half of the tribe of Manasse, To-day we know that the Lord is with us, because ye have not trespassed grievously against the Lord, and because ye have delivered the children of Israel out of the hand of the Lord.
translations.kjv: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, This day we perceive that the LORD is among us, because ye have not committed this trespass against the LORD: now ye have delivered the children of Israel out of the hand of the LORD.
translations.ron: Şi a zis Finees, fiul preotului Eleazar, către fiii lui Ruben şi către fiii lui Gad şi către jumătatea de seminţie a lui Manase: "Astăzi am aflat noi că Domnul este în mijlocul nostru şi că voi n-aţi făcut prin aceasta o nelegiuire; acum aţi izbăvit pe fiii lui Israel din mâna Domnului".
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Φινεὲς ὁ ἱερεὺς τοῖς υἱοῖς Ῥουβὴν καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Γὰδ καὶ τῷ ἡμίσει φυλῆς Μανασσῆ, σήμερον ἐγνώκαμεν ὅτι μεθʼ ἡμῶν Κύριος, διότι οὐκ ἐπλημμελήσατε ἐναντίον Κυρίου πλημμέλειαν, καὶ ὅτι ἐῤῥύσασθε τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἰσραὴλ ἐκ χειρὸς Κυρίου.

verses.geez:
ወገብአ ፡ ፊንሕስ ፡ ወልደ ፡ እልዐዛር ፡ ወመላእክት ፡ አምነ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ሮቤል ፡ ወደቂቀ ፡ ጋድ ፡ ወእምነ ፡ መንፈቀ
                  ፡ ነገደ ፡ መናሴ ፡ እምነ ፡ ገላአድ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ከናኣን ፡ ኀበ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወነገርዎሙ ።
verses.translation: So Phinees the priest and the princes departed from the children of Ruben, and from the children of Gad, and from the half tribe of Manasse out of Galaad into the land of Chanaan to the children of Israel; and reported the words to them.

translations.lxx: So Phinees the priest and the princes departed from the children of Ruben, and from the children of Gad, and from the half tribe of Manasse out of Galaad into the land of Chanaan to the children of Israel; and reported the words to them.
translations.kjv: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, unto the land of Canaan, to the children of Israel, and brought them word again.
translations.ron: Şi s-a întors Finees, fiul preotului Eleazar, şi căpeteniile de la fiii lui Ruben şi de la fiii lui Gad şi de la jumătatea de seminţie a lui Manase din pământul Galaadului în ţara Canaan la fiii lui Israel şi le-a adus răspunsul.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπέστρεψε Φινεὲς ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν Ῥουβὴν καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν Γὰδ καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ ἡμίσους φυλῆς Μανασσῆ ἐκ τῆς Γαλαὰδ εἰς γῆν Χαναὰν πρὸς τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἰσραήλ· καὶ ἀπεκρίθησαν αὐτοῖς τοὺς λόγους.

verses.geez:
ወአደሞሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ነገር ፡ ወሶበ ፡ ነገርዎሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ባረክዎ ፡ ለአምላከ ፡
                  ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወይቤሉ ፡ ኢንዕርግ ፡ እንከ ፡ ኀቤሆሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ንትቃተሎሙ ፡ ወከመ ፡ ናጥፍኣ ፡ ለምድረ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡
                  ሮቤል ፡ ወደቂቀ ፡ ጋድ ፡ ወዘመንፈቀ ፡ ነገደ ፡ መናሴ ፤ ወነበሩ ፡ ላዕሌ[ሃ] ።
verses.translation: And it pleased the children of Israel; and they spoke to the children of Israel, and blessed the God of the children of Israel, and told them to go up no more to war against the others to destroy the land of the children of Ruben, and the children of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasse: so they dwelt upon it.

translations.lxx: And it pleased the children of Israel; and they spoke to the children of Israel, and blessed the God of the children of Israel, and told them to go up no more to war against the others to destroy the land of the children of Ruben, and the children of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasse: so they dwelt upon it.
translations.kjv: And the thing pleased the children of Israel; and the children of Israel blessed God, and did not intend to go up against them in battle, to destroy the land wherein the children of Reuben and Gad dwelt.
translations.ron: Şi le-a plăcut aceasta fiilor lui Israel şi au binecuvântat fiii lui Israel pe Dumnezeu şi au zis să nu se mai ridice împotriva lor cu război, ca să pustiiască ţara în care locuiau fiii lui Ruben şi fiii lui Gad şi jumătate din seminţia lui Manase.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἤρεσε τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσραήλ· καὶ ἐλάλησαν πρὸς τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἰσραὴλ, καὶ εὐλόγησαν τὸν Θεὸν υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ· καὶ εἶπαν μηκέτι ἀναβῆναι πρὸς αὐτοὺς εἰς πόλεμον ἐξολοθρεῦσαι τὴν γῆν τῶν υἱῶν Ῥουβὴν καὶ τῶν υἱων Γὰδ καὶ τοῦ ἡμίσους φυλῆς Μανασσῆ· καὶ κατῴκησαν ἐπʼ αὐτῆς.

verses.geez:
ወሰመዮ ፡ ኢየሱስ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ ዘሮቤል ፡ ወዘጋድ ፡ ወዘመንፈቀ ፡ ነገደ ፡ መናሴ ፡ ወይቤሉ ፡ እስመ ፡ ስምዕ
                  ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ማእከሎሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ውእቱ ፡ አምላኮሙ ።
verses.translation: And Joshua gave a name to the altar of the children of Ruben, and the children of Gad, and of the half tribe of Manasse; and said, It is a testimony in the midst of them, that the Lord is their God.

translations.lxx: And Joshua gave a name to the altar of the children of Ruben, and the children of Gad, and of the half tribe of Manasse; and said, It is a testimony in the midst of them, that the Lord is their God.
translations.kjv: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad called the altar Ed: for it shall be a witness between us that the LORD is God.
translations.ron: Iar fiii lui Ruben şi fiii lui Gad şi jumătate din seminţia lui Manase au numit jertfelnicul Ed, adică mărturie, căci îşi ziceau: Acesta este mărturie între noi că Domnul este Dumnezeul nostru.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπωνόμασεν Ἰησοῦς τὸν βωμὸν τῶν Ῥουβὴν καὶ τῶν Γὰδ καὶ τοῦ ἡμίσους φυλῆς Μανασσῆ, καὶ εἶπεν, ὅτι μαρτύριόν ἐστιν ἀναμέσον αὐτῶν, ὅτι Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς αὐτῶν ἐστι.
